metadata.description:
Azure API Management AI Gateway tier (preview) with a managed-identity Foundry
provider, a Model Router registration that falls back to GPT-5-mini, and an
OpenAPI ToolServer, all governed by structured token, request rate limit, and
content safety policies.
Name of the Foundry account that hosts the model deployment.
Foundry account endpoint used by the AI Gateway model provider.
Resource ID of the Foundry model deployment exposed by the gateway.
Model deployment name clients send in the model field.
Underlying Foundry model name, separate from the deployment identifier.
Version of the model behind the Foundry deployment.
Resource ID of the Model Router deployment fronted by the gateway.
Model Router deployment name clients send in the model field.
Underlying Foundry model name behind the Model Router deployment.
Version of the model behind the Model Router deployment.
Consecutive Model Router failures that trip the fallback to the secondary model.
How long traffic keeps flowing to the fallback model after the circuit trips.
Per-caller token allowance for the registered model during each minute.
Per-caller request allowance for the registered model and tool server during each rate limit window.
Length of the request rate limit window in seconds.
Severity threshold applied to every content safety category before a prompt is blocked. Medium is balanced filtering.
Public base URL of the BuildingAssist backend API.
